newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Menem to pay official visit to Germany.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Menem to pay official visit to Germany.

text.p: President Carlos Menem will make a three-day official visit to Germany beginning on Monday, May 26, to meet Chancellor Helmut Kohl and President Roman Herzog, the Argentine government announced on Sunday.

Menem, accompanied by his ministers of economy, defence and foreign affairs, and a delegation of Argentine business leaders, will visit Bonn and Berlin to meet German officials and industrialists. They aim to boost two-way trade and strengthen Argentina's links with the European Union.
Argentina is a member of the South American trading group Mercosur, along with Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay.

Menem will then fly to Cyprus to spend a day with Argentine troops taking part in United Nations peacekeeping activities in partnership with Britain -- Argentina's former enemy in the 1982 war over the Falkland Islands.
